subject: Intermittent 5xxs from Aeros-3b: customer impact & remediation timeline
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@skybound.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Intermittent 5xxs from Aeros-3b: initial notice

Hi Alex —

I wanted to flag that we observed an uptick in 5xx/timeout responses originating from the Aeros-3b model serving pool that backs your "ContentSummarize" route. We see a ~12% error rate over the last 20 minutes for requests with long context (>= 6k tokens). Impact appears intermittent — some requests succeed on retry.

What we're doing now:
- Routing policy: temporarily diverting new requests to a compatible Aeros-3b-quantized variant in us-west while we investigate.
- Throttle: applying targeted concurrency caps for your org to reduce cascading failures.
- Data collection: capturing detailed RPC traces and the full model-side stderr for affected calls (attached a short sample).

Immediate ask from you: are you running any high-batch inference jobs or scheduled background sweepers that could change request shape? That will help rule out workload-driven caching/kv behavior.

We’ll follow up with a status update in 30–60 minutes or sooner if we have a mitigation. Sorry for the interruption — we know this affects your customers.

Best,
Irene Choi
Principal Account Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0126

Attachment: aeros3b_error_sample_20281103.log (text/plain) - selected stderr + request hashes

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@skybound.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 09:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent 5xxs from Aeros-3b: initial notice

Thanks Irene — we saw failures in our customer-facing endpoint about 09:10 PT. We're not running scheduled jobs; most traffic is user-driven. Two quick notes:
- We do have a surge of longer prompts this morning due to a batch import of legacy docs (started at 08:45).
- Our retry logic is set to 2 immediate retries with exponential backoff.

Appreciate the mitigation and the quick response. Please keep us posted on whether you recommend a permanent model fallback or config change on our side.

Alex Moreno
Head of Platform, SkyBound AI
alex.moreno@skybound.ai

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@skybound.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Intermittent 5xxs from Aeros-3b: initial notice — next steps (ops coordination)

Team — forwarding Alex's reply; their traffic pattern shows a batch of long-context requests that aligns with the timing. Immediate plan:

1) Ben / Sean: confirm whether the Aeros-3b primary pool has any recent kernel or quant change deployments in the last 48h. If yes, push a rollback patch to the canary variant.
2) Jonas: spin up an additional Aeros-3b-quantized fallback cluster in us-west-2 and add it to the routing pool (conservative weights). Estimate: 18–30 minutes.
3) Marissa: notify Support and set a dedicated Slack bridge with SkyBound; prepare a templated customer status update.
4) Irene: keep Alex in the loop; confirm whether we should proactively extend retries or suggest client-side batching adjustments.

I've attached the short stderr sample we captured. Ben — initial look shows repeated KV cache misses plus an out-of-memory spike correlated to a small subset of large-context requests. If we can confirm OOMs, we should mark those machines as cordoned to avoid affecting healthy requests.

Irene

Attachment: mitigation_runbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf) - targeted steps for Aeros-3b incidents

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@skybound.ai>, procurement@skybound.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Nov 2028 18:02:00 -0800
Subject: Aeros-3b elevated 5xxs — resolution summary and postmortem next steps

Alex / SkyBound team —

Summary:
- Incident window: 2028-11-03T08:52:00-08:00 through 2028-11-03T10:40:00-08:00 (partial recovery followed by configuration stabilization).
- Impact: ~11–13% elevated 5xx rate on your ContentSummarize route for long-context requests; visible to a subset (~18%) of sessions that had >6k-token inputs.
- Root cause (preliminary): a recent runtime kernel selection change caused suboptimal memory reservation for longer sequences on a subset of Aeros-3b backends; under high tail-context loads this produced transient OOMs and request-level timeouts.

What we did:
- Immediately removed the new kernel from the primary pool and diverted traffic to a tested quantized variant.
- Cordoned affected hosts and cycled the worker pool to reclaim memory.
- Added an autoscaling rule tweak: raise soft concurrency limits for long-context paths and enable progressive prefetch on KV layers to reduce miss amplification.
- Deployed a monitoring alert with a higher-fidelity OOM signature to detect recurrence.

Customer impact remediation:
- We applied a traffic-routing policy for SkyBound to route long-context requests to the quantized variant for 72 hours while we validate stability. This was done with no change required on your end.
- We recommend you keep current retry config (2 retries) and add client-side circuit-breaker for >8s tail latencies. If you'd like, we can provide a small client library tweak to make that transparent.

Next steps / Postmortem:
- We will circulate a detailed postmortem (shared doc) by 2028-11-09 with timeline, artifacted traces, and remediation experiments.
- Engineering will run a controlled load test against long-context scenarios and publish regression tests for kernel selection.
- We’ll offer a one-time credit against November usage for the incident window; Marissa from CS will follow up with exact numbers and the credit memo.

Attachments: aeros3b_postmortem_draft.docx (postmortem draft)

Thanks again for the quick coordination and patience — we’ll send the full RCA and the final mitigations this week.

Best,
Irene Choi
Principal Account Lead, Redwood Inference
